Our priority during ongoing extreme weather crises should be people's safety. Not spreading lies.

Families have lost loved ones. They're returning to homes to find they have nowhere to sleep. Firefighters are putting their lives on the line to prevent more suffering.

Do better.

As National Nutrition Month comes to a close, I’m introducing the Nutrition Counseling Aiding Recovery for Eating Disorders (Nutrition CARE) Act with @RepBrianFitz, @RepPaulTonko & @RepDonBacon. 

This bill will expand access to life-saving eating disorder treatment for seniors.

Eating disorders affect seniors at rates similar to the general population, but Medicare doesn’t cover Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) for these conditions, leaving seniors & people with disabilities without access to necessary treatment.

Left untreated, eating disorders can lead to heart failure, kidney failure, diabetes, and more, which is why the Nutrition CARE Act is so critical. This bill will help ensure that all individuals with eating disorders can access the services they need to recover and stay healthy.

I'm grateful to my colleagues for partnering with me to make Medicare more comprehensive. For more information on the bill and @EDCoalition and my colleagues' statements in support, please visit:

60 years ago today, Medicare & Medicaid were signed into law. These programs are the reason why millions of Americans can access basic health care & live with dignity.

Today, these lifelines are under attack. Trump and Republicans' Big Ugly Law makes the largest cut to Medicaid in history & slashes $500 billion from Medicare. But @HouseDemocrats won’t back down.

We’ll keep fighting to protect, strengthen & expand health care them for generations to come.

Three years ago yesterday, the PACT Act became law, the largest expansion of Veterans’ healthcare in decades.

I was proud to help pass it.

Now, Trump has fired thousands of Vets, attacked the VA & gutted their union rights. I’ll keep fighting for those who served. https://t.co/JFZlIsG05d

From tariffs to the Big Ugly Bill, Trump's policies do the same thing: rip off hardworking Americans to line the pockets of his billionaire buddies.

Trump’s Health Care Plan: 15 million people get kicked off health insurance, while fraudsters get pardoned.

Their law strips coverage from 15 million people, guts clinics that serve Medicaid patients, and punishes providers that offer abortion services. No one sees lower costs, and millions get left without access to primary care, contraception, cancer screenings, or HIV prevention. It's despicable.

I'm fighting back w/ @ReproCaucus because every patient deserves the right to trusted care.

At today’s @WaysMeansCmte hearing, I urged Republicans to stop sabotaging the economy and rubber stamping Trump's tariffs, and instead work with Democrats to lower costs, protect health care, & strengthen Medicare & Social Security.

Trump’s economy is failing working families. Republicans are choosing to enable his harmful policies.

Republicans control the House, the Senate, and the White House. If the government shuts down, they own it. And they will be the reason that millions of Americans lose their health insurance or have to pay twice as much to keep it. https://t.co/2Hzxcs9XJJ

Republicans already cut $1 TRILLION from Medicaid—the backbone of community health centers.

Now they’re shutting down the government because they refuse to extend ACA tax credits. That means 61,000 people in CA-28 will see their premiums soar by up to 75%.

Every part of our health care system—clinics, hospitals, prescriptions, insurance—is under attack because Trump & Republicans would rather cut taxes for billionaires.

3 months ago, Republicans passed a law that ripped health insurance away from 15 million Americans. Yesterday, they shut down the government rather than fix the crisis they created or lift a finger to stop millions more Americans from losing their coverage when ACA tax credits expire.

Now they are spreading blatant lies about how federal health coverage works in a desperate attempt to distract from how painful it will be for people when their premiums double in cost, when they lose health care altogether, and when their local hospital closes its doors.

What Republicans have done to our health care system is reckless and cruel.

Democrats stand ready to negotiate when Republicans are serious about reversing this damage and protecting working families.

Republicans care more about hiding the Epstein files than helping the American people.
 
Day 3 of their shutdown: Speaker Johnson just cancelled next week’s votes instead of working to end this shutdown.  
Democrats are ready to end the crisis, cut costs & protect healthcare.

All while Trump and Republicans are making health care unaffordable for millions. By refusing to extend ACA tax credits, they’re forcing families to pay thousands more as premiums, copays, and deductibles double or triple.

Californians could see their health care costs more than DOUBLE next year.

A couple making $85k/year in Pasadena could see their premiums jump from $665 to over $2,064 PER MONTH.

Why? Because Republicans want to end the ACA tax credits that keep premiums affordable. https://t.co/ZuYXIcWp8r

Today I visited Herald Christian Health Center in Rosemead—a community health center that helps thousands enroll in Medi-Cal and Covered California & provides lifesaving care regardless of income or insurance.

But Trump & Republicans gutted the programs that make that care possible—slashing Medicaid, weakening the ACA, and kicking 15 million Americans off coverage. And now they’re refusing to extend ACA tax credits, driving up premiums for millions more. Democrats are fighting back.

Health care premiums are about to DOUBLE for MILLIONS of Americans. 
 
Democrats are fighting to stop it.
House Republicans? Still on day 31 of vacation.
